entries.prompt: Edit reference image into a clean reusable Lumia Chronicles Life-mode bedroom background plate, 1920x1080 landscape 16:9. Preserve its warm hand-painted storybook academic fantasy, cream stone, honey oak beams, sage bedding, restrained brass, huge left arched window and lake vista in same daytime light, rear fireplace and same furniture designs. Critical composition correction: pull desk and chair far back directly against the left window wall, smaller and fully behind the character plane; place the bed deep at rear center, not protruding into foreground; simplify/recede rug. Leave an unobstructed calm standing zone in left foreground x15-35% and right foreground x68-85%, both above lower 25% reserved for future dialogue overlay. Neither foreground seat should be occupied by furniture. Keep an intimate room, no palace enlargement. REMOVE owl Bern entirely (will be composited separately), remove all labels/buttons/UI/text and characters. Two-character conversation stage, eye-level slightly elevated interior, not isometric. No extra props or new decor. Background only.

Create ONE large connected adventure-level OVERVIEW, landscape 16:9, ideally 3840x2160 for map detail. Reference is solely Lumia's approved visual STYLE/MATERIAL reference, NOT its tiny courtyard layout. Warm hand-painted watercolor/pencil storybook 2.5D botanical fantasy, cream paving, sage foliage, restrained brass glass arches, turquoise accents, matte diffuse daylight. Critical spatial scale: depict an EXPANSIVE greenhouse garden estate with 6 widely separated explorable districts connected by long but interesting winding walkable paths, lateral branches, distinct garden rooms with dense hedges occluding neighboring districts. Not one courtyard or one circular garden. Very high oblique orthographic overview, no horizon, consistent scale everywhere. Entire world comprises dozens of screen-sized garden spaces. Southwest entrance forecourt at x15% y85%; vine arcade x25% y65%; wilted research beds x25% y35%; far eastern moon herb terraces x72% y68%; clue garden x72% y38%; quiet final rune clearing x52% y18%. Connect all via continuous cream paths, secondary loops through nursery beds; preserve clear walking lanes. Glass-and-brass greenhouse partitions, shrubs, small trees and modest bridges separate rooms, no giant new castles, towns or mountains. Central final clearing should be EMPTY paved floor (rune will be layered later). No characters, UI, lettering, numbers, arrows, borders, grid, icons or inset maps. Do not make distant districts tiny perspective objects. Coherent game-level environment not dramatic landscape. Existing reference's charm at a MUCH larger traversable scale.
